fusions.name: Fixing Glance
fusions.desc: A glance that deals 4 damage, with a 25% chance to hold the target [Pinned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Wards Open Underfoot
fusions.desc: Opens the watching wards set in the ground around you. The burst deals 26 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each [Exposed] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Watching Post
fusions.desc: Plants a watching post beside you for 15 seconds that strikes enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each strike has a 40% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Counting Its Steps
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (122% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
